Use case: premium mobile slot game key art
Asset type: original slot cabinet and surrounding stage
Primary request: a complete jade-and-brass traditional slot cabinet embedded in a moonlit lantern pavilion, front-facing three-quarter view, thick carved jade frame, inset glass reel window, sculpted brass edge, tactile central spin medallion, two small side controls, soft reflected lantern light, grounded contact shadow, subtle floating silk banners behind, luxurious but gentle cartoon realism, clear open screen window for software reels
Composition/framing: portrait mobile 2:3, cabinet centered and fully visible, leave space around outer edge for Cocos overlays, screen opening must be rectangular and unobstructed
Constraints: no text, no logo, no numbers, no symbols in reels, no extra buttons, no detached UI cards, no plastic toy look, no hard neon, no watermark
